en: A colorized postcard illustration of the ocean liner 'VATERLAND' at sea, showing a large black-hulled passenger ship with four yellow funnels and extensive deck structures. The ship cuts through choppy water under a pastel sky. At the bow the name 'VATERLAND' is visible. In the upper left a flag with the Hamburg-Amerika Linie (HAPAG) crest is shown. On the right side there is red German text describing the ship's dimensions and capacity.
